'''Bodrum Futbol Kulübü''', known as '''Sipay Bodrumspor''' due to sponsorship reasons, is a Turkish professional football club based in the resort town of [[Bodrum]], [[Muğla Province]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Sponsorship and naming rights |url=https://bodrumspor.com/reklam-ve-sponsorluk/ |website=Bodrum FK Official |language=tr |access-date=16 August 2025}}</ref> Established in 1931, the club spent much of its early existence in amateur leagues before gradually rising through the [[Turkish football league system|Turkish football pyramid]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Bodrum FK's dramatic rise to the Süper Lig |url=https://www.dha.com.tr/spor/bodrum-fk-super-lig-dramatic-journey-4289275 |work=DHA |date=19 May 2024 |language=en |access-date=16 August 2025}}</ref>

As of the 2024–25 season, Bodrum FK made its debut in Turkey’s top division, the [[Süper Lig]], after winning the promotion play-off final in 2024 to become the first club ever from Muğla Province to reach that level.<ref>{{cite news |title=Bodrum becomes first Muğla club in Süper Lig |url=https://www.beinsports.com.tr/haber/bodrum-makes-history-as-first-mugla-club-in-super-lig |work=beIN SPORTS Türkiye |date=31 May 2024 |language=tr |access-date=16 August 2025}}</ref>

The club plays its home matches at the [[:tr:Bodrum İlçe Stadyumu|Grey Beton Bodrum İlçe Stadyumu]], a modest venue that met licensing requirements following upgrades ahead of its top-flight entry.<ref>{{cite web |title=Grey Beton sponsorship and stadium updates |url=https://bodrumspor.com/reklam-ve-sponsorluk/ |website=Bodrum FK Official |language=tr |access-date=16 August 2025}}</ref>"}}
